+"""PL-01 step 3: align the rows on one calendar."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+from mdata.types import Prices, RawRow
+
+
+def align_calendar(rows: Sequence[RawRow], *, max_gap: int = 5) -> Prices:
+    """Spine: only the dates every ticker has a close on; nothing is filled, so no gap applies."""
+    del max_gap
+    closes: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        if row.close is not None:
+            closes.setdefault(row.ticker, {})[row.date] = row.close
+    tickers = tuple(sorted(closes))
+    shared = set.intersection(*(set(by_date) for by_date in closes.values())) if closes else set()
+    dates = tuple(sorted(shared))
+    return Prices(
+        dates=dates,
+        tickers=tickers,
+        closes={ticker: tuple(closes[ticker][day] for day in dates) for ticker in tickers},
+    )

+"""PL-01 step 1: read the rows of a `date,ticker,close` CSV."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import csv
+from datetime import date
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mdata.types import RawRow
+
+COLUMNS = ("date", "ticker", "close")
+
+
+def read_csv(path: str | Path) -> list[RawRow]:
+    """Every row in file order; a blank close is None. ValueError for a missing column or bad date."""
+    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
+        missing = [column for column in COLUMNS if column not in (reader.fieldnames or ())]
+        if missing:
+            msg = f"{path}: missing column(s) {', '.join(missing)}"
+            raise ValueError(msg)
+        return [_parse_row(record) for record in reader]
+
+
+def _parse_row(record: dict[str, str]) -> RawRow:
+    """One CSV record as a RawRow, checking the date is ISO yyyy-mm-dd."""
+    day = record["date"].strip()
+    if not _is_iso_date(day):
+        msg = f"malformed date {day!r}"
+        raise ValueError(msg)
+    close = record["close"].strip()
+    return RawRow(date=day, ticker=record["ticker"].strip(), close=float(close) if close else None)
+
+
+def _is_iso_date(text: str) -> bool:
+    """True when `text` is a real date written as yyyy-mm-dd."""
+    try:
+        return date.fromisoformat(text).isoformat() == text
+    except ValueError:
+        return False

+"""PL-01 step 2: keep the usable rows, sorted by (date, ticker)."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+from mdata.types import RawRow
+
+
+def validate_rows(rows: Sequence[RawRow], tickers: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> list[RawRow]:
+    """Spine: the rows with a close (of `tickers`, when given), sorted by (date, ticker)."""
+    wanted = None if tickers is None else set(tickers)
+    kept = [
+        row for row in rows if row.close is not None and (wanted is None or row.ticker in wanted)
+    ]
+    return sorted(kept, key=lambda row: (row.date, row.ticker))

+"""read_csv: every row in file order, blank closes missing, malformed files rejected."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+from mdata.io import read_csv
+from mdata.types import RawRow
+
+
+def _write(tmp_path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(text)
+    return path
+
+
+def test_rows_come_back_in_file_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-03,B,20.5\n2024-01-02,A,10\n")
+    assert read_csv(path) == [
+        RawRow(date="2024-01-03", ticker="B", close=20.5),
+        RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=10.0),
+    ]
+
+
+def test_blank_close_is_none_not_zero(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker,close\n2024-01-02,A,\n")
+    assert read_csv(str(path)) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=None)]
+
+
+def test_columns_may_come_in_any_order(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "ticker,close,date\nA,1.5,2024-01-02\n")
+    assert read_csv(path) == [RawRow(date="2024-01-02", ticker="A", close=1.5)]
+
+
+def test_missing_column_is_a_value_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, "date,ticker\n2024-01-02,A\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="close"):
+        read_csv(path)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("day", ["2024/01/02", "20240102", "2024-02-30", "yesterday"])
+def test_malformed_date_is_a_value_error(tmp_path: Path, day: str) -> None:
+    path = _write(tmp_path, f"date,ticker,close\n{day},A,1.0\n")
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="malformed date"):
+        read_csv(path)

+"""PL-01 smoke: load_prices runs end to end on a synthetic CSV and returns well-shaped Prices."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from mdata import Prices, load_prices
+
+CSV = """date,ticker,close
+2024-03-04,AAA,101.25
+2024-03-04,BBB,48.6
+2024-03-05,AAA,102.1
+2024-03-05,BBB,49.0
+2024-03-06,AAA,100.8
+2024-03-06,BBB,49.3
+2024-03-07,AAA,103.4
+2024-03-07,BBB,49.9
+"""
+
+
+def test_pl01_runs_end_to_end_and_returns_prices(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(CSV)
+    prices = load_prices(path)
+    assert isinstance(prices, Prices)
+    assert prices.tickers == ("AAA", "BBB")
+    assert len(prices.dates) == 4
+    assert set(prices.closes) == {"AAA", "BBB"}
+    assert all(len(closes) == len(prices.dates) for closes in prices.closes.values())
+
+
+def test_pl01_narrows_to_the_requested_tickers(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    path = tmp_path / "prices.csv"
+    path.write_text(CSV)
+    prices = load_prices(path, ["BBB"])
+    assert prices.tickers == ("BBB",)
+    assert set(prices.closes) == {"BBB"}

7	from mdata.types import Prices, RawRow

10	def align_calendar(rows: Sequence[RawRow], *, max_gap: int = 5) -> Prices:
11	    """Spine: only the dates every ticker has a close on; nothing is filled, so no gap applies."""
12	    del max_gap
13	    closes: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
14	    for row in rows:
15	        if row.close is not None:
16	            closes.setdefault(row.ticker, {})[row.date] = row.close
17	    tickers = tuple(sorted(closes))
18	    shared = set.intersection(*(set(by_date) for by_date in closes.values())) if closes else set()
19	    dates = tuple(sorted(shared))
20	    return Prices(
21	        dates=dates,
22	        tickers=tickers,
23	        closes={ticker: tuple(closes[ticker][day] for day in dates) for ticker in tickers},

2	
3	from __future__ import annotations
4	
5	import csv
6	from datetime import date
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	from mdata.types import RawRow
10	
11	COLUMNS = ("date", "ticker", "close")
12	
13	
14	def read_csv(path: str | Path) -> list[RawRow]:
15	    """Every row in file order; a blank close is None. ValueError for a missing column or bad date."""
16	    with Path(path).open(newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
17	        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
18	        missing = [column for column in COLUMNS if column not in (reader.fieldnames or ())]
19	        if missing:
20	            msg = f"{path}: missing column(s) {', '.join(missing)}"
21	            raise ValueError(msg)
22	        return [_parse_row(record) for record in reader]
23	
24	
25	def _parse_row(record: dict[str, str]) -> RawRow:
26	    """One CSV record as a RawRow, checking the date is ISO yyyy-mm-dd."""
27	    day = record["date"].strip()
28	    if not _is_iso_date(day):
29	        msg = f"malformed date {day!r}"
30	        raise ValueError(msg)
31	    close = record["close"].strip()
32	    return RawRow(date=day, ticker=record["ticker"].strip(), close=float(close) if close else None)
33	
34	
35	def _is_iso_date(text: str) -> bool:
36	    """True when `text` is a real date written as yyyy-mm-dd."""
37	    try:
38	        return date.fromisoformat(text).isoformat() == text
39	    except ValueError:
40	        return False
